negatives: An earlier segment_nuclei draft with a leaky watershed (no background basin) scored 7.0% and a second draft 5.8% on BBBC001; both were geometrically wrong (synthetic 121-px disks came out 145/109/109 then 81 px). The shipped version is the one that passes the synthetic geometry checks, scoring 8.2%; no parameter was tuned to the 6 ground-truth images.
Circularity estimator 4piA/P^2 with P=edges*pi/4 reads 0.91 on a digital r=6 disk (estimator bias, documented).
data_note: BBBC001 v1: 6 Hoechst-only 512x512 HT29 fields + two-human counts (https://bbbc.broadinstitute.org/BBBC001). Pixel size is not published on the page, so state_from_nuclei_image requires it from acquisition metadata.
verdict: VALIDATED with BUG 64 fixed; new real-image entry point segment_nuclei/state_from_nuclei_image
